title: Microsoft 365 Copilot: Employee Self-Service agent for HR and IT questions and tasks
summary: The briefing's rollout facts, licensing routes, approval controls and Graph operations are supported by the roadmap and Microsoft documentation. Minor corrections should distinguish the publishing wizard from audience selection, describe sandbox deployment as a recommendation, and acknowledge the conflicting guidance about blocking in Teams.

claims.quote: Blocking or unblocking an agent that you created by using Microsoft Copilot Agent Builder and Microsoft Copilot Studio affects its availability and functionality in Microsoft Copilot. It also affects availability and functionality in other host products

claims.fix: After this statement add 'However, the Teams governance page says tenants migrated to unified app management can allow or block an agent in either admin center; confirm your tenant's management model before treating a Teams block as isolated from Copilot.' Cite https://learn.microsoft.com/microsoftteams/manage-apps#allow-or-block.
